verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own accounting sync: one-click accounting system setup, automatic expense data sync to Puzzle, and an Accounting API for connecting to an accounting system. However, the evidence never names QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero as sync targets. It also never shows user-controlled GL account, class, or department mappings. missing for 10: documented sync to QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero, user-controlled GL account mapping, class and department mapping controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control

citations.quote: Set up your accounting system in one click.
Prepared expense data sync automatically to eliminate manual set up or matching between Brex and Puzzle.
The Accounting API allows you to manage accounting data for connecting to your accounting system.
